(strong stem, म॑न्थन्, older म॑न्था; middle मथि॑न् or मथि॑ [q.v.]; sg. nom. म॑न्थास् acc. म॑न्थाम् [for मन्थानम् See मन्थान under √ मन्थ्] ; instr. मथा॑ du. मथि॑भ्याम् pl. मथि॑भ्यस् &c. [cf. पथिन् and Pāṇ. vii, 1, 83 &c.]; for मथीना॑म् See मथि above) a churning-stick, any stick or staff for stirring or churning, RV. &c. &c.

N. of various towns (esp. of an ancient town now called Muttra and held in great honour as the birthplace of Kṛṣṇa; situated in the province of Agra on the right bank of the Yamunā or Jumna; described in VP. xii, 1 as having been founded by Śatru-ghna; accord. to Kull. on Mn. ii, 19 it forms part of a district called Brahmarṣi, belonging to Śūra-sena), AV.Pariś.; Hariv.; Pur. &c.
